# MP3 encoding

lamejs 1.2.1, unmodified `lame.min.js`, downloaded from the npm package.
Corresponding source: [original npm source package](lamejs-source-1.2.1.tgz), including src/ and the browser library.
Project: https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs
LAME: https://lame.sourceforge.net/
License: LGPL-3.0; upstream notice included as lamejs-LICENSE.
Used as a separate worker-loaded library; no external runtime/CDN request.
